calls.reason: This is an open-ended forecast with no deadline. ARC Prize and the AGI Society both say Astra is not proven to be AGI, but AGI not arriving yet cannot settle a claim that it never will.

GPT-4o mini, Claude 3 Haiku and the Trainium work show some efficiency effort. But none of the evidence shows how much funding and hyperscaler deals actually weakened the pressure to economise, so this causal hypothesis stays open.

DeepSeek did release MIT-licensed weights and a technical report. Hugging Face notes that no training code was released, though, and nothing in the packet independently shows the market had become a commodity by January 2025.

OpenAI's 80% o3 price cut was put down to inference optimisation, not to competing with DeepSeek, so the condition is not shown. OpenAI's 2025 losses grew, but no record ties that growth to price cuts.

Audited figures reported by Ars Technica put OpenAI's 2024 net loss just over $5B on about $3.7B revenue. Anthropic's S-1 shows a 2024 operating loss of $2.98B, which is just under $3B, though its net loss was higher.

The condition, OpenAI adopting DeepSeek's approach as a concession, is not established, and 'potentially fatal' is hedged. OpenAI's $122B round shows continued funding but says nothing about whether investors hesitated.
